problems.title: Product of Array Except Self
problems.solution: Create prefix and postfix products. For each element, multiply prefix product by postfix product.
problems.code:
def productExceptSelf(nums):
    n = len(nums)
    result = [1] * n
    prefix = 1
    for i in range(n):
        result[i] = prefix
        prefix *= nums[i]
    postfix = 1
    for i in range(n-1, -1, -1):
        result[i] *= postfix
        postfix *= nums[i]
    return result

categories.name: Linked Lists
categories.description: Solve problems involving linked list operations and traversal

problems.title: Reverse Linked List
problems.solution: Iterate through the list and reverse pointers. Keep track of previous, current, and next nodes.
problems.code:
def reverseList(head):
    prev = None
    while head:
        next_temp = head.next
        head.next = prev
        prev = head
        head = next_temp
    return prev
